title: Bill Holden: Kennedy on Air Force One says UFOs are out of his hands
place_text: Air Force One, en route to Berlin

tellings.quote: this. Kennedy turned to him and says, "I know this is true and I know these are real, but the whole matter is out of my hands and I don't know why."
Jack Kennedy said the same thing to Bill Holden, his the stu chief steward on Air Force One.
tellings.difference: Gives the time only as Kennedy's presidency, with no Berlin trip named, and puts it as Kennedy saying 'the same thing' as Eisenhower.
tellings.link_reason: Both tellings are Greer relaying what steward Bill Holden said: that Kennedy, on Air Force One, told him the UFO matter was out of his hands.

as_told.title: Kennedy told Air Force One steward Bill Holden he had been sidelined

plain: In 1963, on Air Force One heading to Berlin, President John F. Kennedy is said to have told his chief steward Bill Holden: "I know this is true and I know these are real, but the whole matter is out of my hands and I don't know why." The UFO activist Steven Greer repeats this as Holden's account, and in a second telling he gives no Berlin trip and says Kennedy said "the same thing" as President Eisenhower. If true, even a president would have been shut out of the UFO secret.
